source: DOAJ API + Curated Top-Tier List (IEEE, ACM, Nature, SCOAP3, Diamond OA)

journals.title: Journal of Machine Learning Research
journals.aims: JMLR is a diamond open-access journal publishing high-quality scholarly articles on all aspects of machine learning. Authors pay no fees, and articles are freely available to all readers. The journal covers statistical learning theory, supervised and unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning, and deep learning.
journals.note: Diamond OA — completely free to publish and read

journals.title: Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research
journals.aims: JAIR is a fully open-access journal covering all areas of artificial intelligence. The journal is free to publish in and free to read, with no APCs. It publishes research in areas including search, planning, knowledge representation, reasoning, natural language processing, robotics, and machine learning.

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
journals.aims: TPAMI is the premier journal for research in computer vision, pattern analysis, and machine intelligence. Authors submit at no charge under the traditional subscription model. It covers image processing, object recognition, scene understanding, generative models, and deep learning architectures.
journals.note: Free under traditional submission — no APC required

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
journals.aims: TNNLS publishes technical articles on the theory, design, and applications of neural networks and related learning systems. Free to publish under IEEE's subscription model. Topics include deep neural networks, recurrent networks, graph neural networks, federated learning, and neuromorphic computing.

journals.title: Artificial Intelligence
journals.aims: Published since 1970, this is one of the oldest and most prestigious AI journals. Authors pay nothing to publish under the subscription model. It covers all aspects of AI including automated reasoning, knowledge representation, planning, constraint satisfaction, multiagent systems, and machine learning.
journals.note: Free under traditional Elsevier subscription route

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
journals.aims: TIP focuses on image and video processing, covering theory, algorithms, and applications. Free to submit and publish under IEEE subscription model. Topics include image enhancement, compression, restoration, super-resolution, medical imaging, video analysis, and generative image synthesis.

journals.title: Theory of Computing
journals.aims: Theory of Computing is a fully diamond open-access journal covering theoretical computer science. Completely free to publish and free to access, with no APCs ever. It publishes research in computational complexity, algorithm design, cryptography, coding theory, and quantum computing.
journals.note: Diamond OA — zero cost to authors or readers

journals.title: Pattern Recognition
journals.aims: Pattern Recognition covers statistical, structural, and syntactic approaches to pattern analysis and machine intelligence. Free to publish under traditional submission. Topics include face recognition, handwriting recognition, biometrics, image classification, and anomaly detection.

journals.title: Neural Networks
journals.aims: Neural Networks is an interdisciplinary journal covering biological and artificial neural systems. Authors pay no APC under traditional subscription. It bridges neuroscience and machine learning, covering spiking neural networks, computational neuroscience, cognitive architectures, and brain-inspired computing.

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics
journals.aims: TCYB covers computational intelligence, systems science, and human-machine interaction. No APC required under IEEE subscription model. Research areas include evolutionary computation, swarm intelligence, fuzzy systems, neural networks, and control systems.

journals.title: Logical Methods in Computer Science
journals.aims: LMCS is a fully diamond open-access journal for research at the intersection of logic and computer science. Completely free to publish and read. It covers type theory, category theory, formal verification, model checking, lambda calculus, and process algebras.

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics
journals.aims: TPEL is the leading journal for power electronics, covering converters, motor drives, and power management systems. Free to submit under IEEE subscription. Topics include DC-DC converters, inverters, renewable energy interfaces, wireless power transfer, and wide-bandgap semiconductor devices.

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics
journals.aims: TIE covers all aspects of industrial electronics including sensors, actuators, power converters, and control systems. No APC required. Topics span industrial IoT, motion control, renewable energy systems, robotics, and smart manufacturing.

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Communications
journals.aims: TCOM publishes research on the theory and practice of communications, including modulation, coding, and network protocols. Free under IEEE subscription model. Topics include 5G/6G, MIMO systems, channel coding, optical communications, and satellite communications.

journals.title: IEEE Journal of Selected Areas in Communications
journals.aims: JSAC publishes special issues on emerging topics in communications and networking. No APC required. Focus areas include machine learning for communications, reconfigurable intelligent surfaces, integrated sensing and communication, and terahertz communications.

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications
journals.aims: TWC covers theoretical and applied research on wireless communications and mobile systems. Free to publish. Research areas include NOMA, massive MIMO, mmWave communications, UAV communications, and physical layer security.

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing
journals.aims: TSP publishes research on signal processing theory, methods, and applications. Free under IEEE subscription. Topics include adaptive filtering, spectral estimation, compressed sensing, sparse signal recovery, graph signal processing, and deep learning for signal processing.

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Power Systems
journals.aims: TPWRS covers all aspects of electric power systems including generation, transmission, distribution, and smart grids. No APC required. Topics include renewable energy integration, demand response, energy storage, power system stability, and grid optimization.

journals.title: Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing
journals.aims: MSSP covers dynamics, vibrations, and signal processing applied to mechanical and structural systems. Authors pay no APC. Research areas include structural health monitoring, fault diagnosis, noise and vibration control, nonlinear dynamics, and modal analysis.

journals.title: International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer
journals.aims: IJHMT is the leading journal for fundamental and applied research on heat and mass transfer. No APC required. Topics include convection, radiation, phase change, micro/nanoscale heat transfer, computational heat transfer, and thermal management of electronics.

journals.title: Journal of Sound and Vibration
journals.aims: JSV covers theoretical, experimental, and computational aspects of sound and vibration. Free to publish under traditional subscription. Areas include structural acoustics, noise control, aeroelasticity, impact dynamics, and vibration-based energy harvesting.

journals.title: New England Journal of Medicine
journals.aims: NEJM is the world's most prestigious medical journal, publishing landmark clinical research, clinical trial results, and medical case reports. Authors submit at no charge under the subscription model. Areas include internal medicine, oncology, cardiology, infectious disease, and clinical pharmacology.
journals.note: Free under traditional subscription — no APC

journals.title: The Lancet
journals.aims: The Lancet is one of the world's oldest and most prestigious medical journals, publishing high-impact clinical research. Authors pay no APC under traditional submission. Topics include global health, infectious diseases, clinical trials, health policy, and population health.

journals.title: JAMA: Journal of the American Medical Association
journals.aims: JAMA is a peer-reviewed general medical journal publishing original research, reviews, and clinical guidelines. No APC required. Topics include clinical research, healthcare quality, medical education, evidence-based medicine, and health policy.

journals.title: IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering
journals.aims: TBME covers engineering principles applied to biology and medicine. Free to publish under IEEE subscription model. Topics include neural engineering, wearable biosensors, medical imaging, prosthetics, brain-computer interfaces, and computational biology.

journals.title: Environmental Science and Technology
journals.aims: ES&T is the premier journal for environmental science and engineering. Authors pay no APC under traditional submission. Research covers air pollution, water treatment, soil contamination, climate change impacts, environmental nanotechnology, and green chemistry.
journals.note: Free under traditional ACS subscription route

journals.title: Water Research
journals.aims: Water Research covers research on water quality, treatment, and management. No APC required. Topics include membrane filtration, advanced oxidation processes, biological wastewater treatment, micropollutant removal, and water reuse.

journals.title: Annals of Mathematics
journals.aims: Annals of Mathematics is the most prestigious mathematics journal in the world, publishing landmark results across all areas of pure mathematics. No APC ever required. Areas include algebraic geometry, number theory, topology, analysis, and mathematical physics.

journals.title: Acta Mathematica
journals.aims: Acta Mathematica is now diamond open access, free to publish and free to read. It publishes the most significant papers in pure mathematics. Topics include complex analysis, differential equations, harmonic analysis, algebraic topology, and geometric analysis.
journals.note: Diamond OA since 2017 — zero cost to authors

journals.title: SIAM Journal on Computing
journals.aims: SICOMP publishes research on the mathematical foundations of computer science. No publication fee for SIAM members. Topics include computational complexity, algorithm design and analysis, cryptography, computational geometry, and parallel computing.

journals.title: Journal of High Energy Physics
journals.aims: JHEP is a leading journal in high energy physics, now fully open access via SCOAP3 — meaning authors never pay any APC; costs are covered by the SCOAP3 library consortium. Topics include collider physics, string theory, quantum field theory, supersymmetry, and lattice QCD.
journals.note: SCOAP3 funded — zero APC for authors worldwide

journals.title: Nuclear Physics B
journals.aims: Nuclear Physics B is fully open access via SCOAP3, with zero APC for authors worldwide. It covers nuclear and particle physics, quantum field theory, string theory, and mathematical physics. SCOAP3 partner libraries collectively fund the journal so authors never pay.

journals.title: Physics Letters B
journals.aims: Physics Letters B is a SCOAP3 journal with no APC for authors. It publishes rapid communications in particle physics, nuclear physics, and cosmology. Topics include the Higgs boson, dark matter, neutrino physics, and experimental results from LHC.

journals.title: Physical Review Letters
journals.aims: PRL is the most prestigious rapid-communication physics journal, covering all areas of physics. Standard submission has no APC. Topics include condensed matter physics, high energy physics, quantum information, atomic physics, and gravitational waves.
journals.note: Free under traditional APS subscription route

journals.title: ACM Transactions on Algorithms
journals.aims: TALG is the leading journal for research on algorithms and data structures. No APC is charged under ACM's traditional submission route. It covers algorithm design, complexity theory, graph algorithms, approximation algorithms, randomized algorithms, and online algorithms.

journals.title: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
journals.aims: NeurIPS is the world's most prestigious machine learning conference. All accepted papers are freely available, and there is no APC or publication fee. Topics include deep learning theory, generative models, reinforcement learning, Bayesian methods, and optimization.
journals.note: No APC — only conference registration fee

journals.title: International Conference on Machine Learning
journals.aims: ICML is a top-tier machine learning conference with no publication fee or APC. Papers are freely available via the PMLR proceedings. Topics include learning theory, kernel methods, probabilistic models, neural architecture search, and federated learning.

journals.title: International Conference on Learning Representations
journals.aims: ICLR focuses on deep learning and representation learning with fully open and free proceedings. No APC or publication fee. Topics include transformers, graph neural networks, self-supervised learning, few-shot learning, and AI safety.

journals.title: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
journals.aims: AAAI is a premier AI conference with free open proceedings and no APC. Topics span the full breadth of AI including automated planning, knowledge representation, natural language processing, computer vision, robotics, and AI ethics.

journals.title: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence
journals.aims: IJCAI is the premier international AI conference, publishing all papers freely with no APC. Topics include constraint programming, game theory, computer vision, natural language processing, machine learning, and autonomous agents.

journals.title: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
journals.aims: CVPR is the world's top computer vision conference with open access proceedings and no publication fee. Topics include object detection, 3D scene understanding, video analysis, generative image models, medical image analysis, and vision-language models.

journals.title: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
journals.aims: ACL is the flagship NLP conference with fully open proceedings and no APC. Topics include large language models, machine translation, sentiment analysis, information extraction, dialogue systems, and multilingual NLP.

journals.title: ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
journals.aims: KDD is the premier data mining and knowledge discovery conference with no APC and open proceedings. Topics include scalable machine learning, graph mining, anomaly detection, time series analysis, and AI applications in industry.

journals.title: ACM SIGMOD International Conference on Management of Data
journals.aims: SIGMOD is the top database research conference with open proceedings and no APC. Topics include query optimization, transaction processing, data integration, cloud databases, graph databases, and machine learning for data systems.

journals.title: ACM SIGCOMM Conference
journals.aims: SIGCOMM is the premier networking conference with free open access proceedings and no publication fee. Topics include Internet architecture, software-defined networking, data center networks, wireless networking, and network measurement.

journals.title: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy
journals.aims: IEEE S&P (Oakland) is the most prestigious security conference. All proceedings are freely accessible and authors pay no publication fee. Topics include system security, cryptographic protocols, network security, privacy-preserving computation, and hardware security.

journals.title: IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering
journals.aims: ICSE is the premier software engineering conference with open proceedings and no publication fee. Topics include program synthesis, software testing, bug detection, software maintenance, DevOps, and AI for software engineering.

journals.title: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
journals.aims: ICRA is the world's largest robotics conference. All proceedings are freely available via IEEE Xplore, and authors pay no APC. Topics include robot perception, motion planning, manipulation, human-robot interaction, autonomous vehicles, and aerial robotics.

journals.title: ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
journals.aims: CHI is the premier HCI conference with open proceedings and no publication fee. Topics include user interface design, accessibility, AR/VR interaction, social computing, health informatics, and AI-human teaming.

journals.title: ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference
journals.aims: DAC is the premier conference for chip design and electronic design automation with open proceedings and no APC. Topics include VLSI design, design verification, hardware security, embedded systems, and AI-driven chip design.

journals.title: IEEE INFOCOM
journals.aims: INFOCOM is a top networking conference with freely accessible proceedings and no APC. Research covers wireless networks, network resource management, edge computing, IoT networking, and network security.

journals.title: ACM Symposium on Operating Systems Principles
journals.aims: SOSP is the most prestigious operating systems conference. Papers are freely available and there is no publication APC. Research areas include file systems, distributed systems, cloud computing, OS security, and system reliability.

journals.title: International Symposium on Computer Architecture
journals.aims: ISCA is the premier computer architecture conference with open proceedings and no publication fee. Topics include processor microarchitecture, memory systems, accelerators for AI, near-memory computing, and quantum computer architecture.

journals.title: Journal of Hazardous Materials
journals.aims: JHM covers all aspects of hazardous materials management and environmental remediation. Free to publish under traditional subscription. Topics include heavy metal contamination, persistent organic pollutants, nanomaterial toxicity, soil remediation, and risk assessment.

journals.title: Applied Thermal Engineering
journals.aims: Applied Thermal Engineering publishes research on the application of thermodynamic and heat transfer principles to practical engineering systems. No APC. Topics include heat exchangers, refrigeration, HVAC systems, industrial furnaces, and waste heat recovery.

journals.title: Discrete Mathematics
journals.aims: Discrete Mathematics covers combinatorics, graph theory, and related areas of mathematics and theoretical computer science. No APC required. Topics include graph coloring, network flows, combinatorial optimization, coding theory, and discrete probability.

journals.title: Reviews of Modern Physics
journals.aims: Reviews of Modern Physics publishes comprehensive tutorial reviews covering all areas of physics. No APC required under standard submission. It is the highest impact-factor physics journal for authoritative reviews of condensed matter, atomic physics, cosmology, and biophysics.

journals.title: USENIX Security Symposium
journals.aims: USENIX Security is a top systems security conference with fully open and free proceedings and no APC. Topics include operating system security, network security, program analysis, fuzzing, authentication, and privacy.
journals.note: No APC — proceedings freely available online

journals.title: ACM SIGPLAN Conference on Programming Language Design and Implementation
journals.aims: PLDI is the top programming languages conference with open proceedings and no APC. Topics include compiler optimization, type systems, program verification, memory management, and domain-specific languages.

journals.title: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation
journals.aims: OSDI is a top systems conference with completely free and open proceedings and no APC. Topics include serverless computing, ML systems, storage systems, network function virtualization, and software-defined systems.
journals.note: No APC — proceedings freely available online
